text:
ben: CI linkcheck failed on main after the migration batch. failing link: /guides/auth#OAuth2-Flow -> 404. looks like the heading used inline code `OAuth2 Flow` and mkdocs slugger yields oauth2-flow whereas old site expected OAuth2.Flow :grimace: claire: yep, i've seen this pattern. mkdocs-material's slugify lowercases and removes punctuation differently. migrating examples with inline code often change anchor values. rafael: short fix: add an explicit id to the heading and keep a legacy anchor for compatibility. e.g.: `

OAuth2 Flow

` ben: can you open a micro-PR? prefer minimal surface change so backports are easy. also add the linkcheck snippet to the PR to help reviewers. rafael: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5077 - tiny patch at docs/guides/auth.md, two commits (anchor compat + lint tidy). pasted failing line from CI: ``` ERROR: /guides/auth#OAuth2.Flow -> 404 (anchor not found) ``` claire: nice. while you're in there, please standardize the codeblock languages (we had mixed `py` and `python` tags) but keep that as a separate commit so reviewers can ignore if needed. docsbot: automated checks queued for PR 5077: linkcheck, markdownlint, spellcheck. preview-bot: Netlify preview requested for branch docs/oauth2-anchor-compat (deploy 100015). ben: one more thing: add a one-line note in CONTRIBUTING.md under "anchors" showing the dual-anchor pattern and when to preserve legacy fragments. small education piece avoids churn. rafael: added that blurb and a tiny example; included CHANGES.md entry "auth anchors: preserve legacy fragments". pushed and requested a preview. preview-bot: Preview available: https://deploy-preview-100015--docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/auth - anchor resolves. docsbot: linkcheck ✅, markdownlint ✅, spellcheck ⚠️ (minor spelling suggestion in example comment) claire: spelling nit is non-blocking. LGTM. merging. ben: filing a follow-up issue to add nightly linkcheck job in infra so we catch these after future migrations. created #1322 and linked in PR. rafael: merged into main. thanks all — short and sweet. closing thread. :wave:
